notes.title: Happy White Day from When the Past was Around!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/2b7cb3918c5cd66b52df5c625a46afe2a58cff19.png[/img]

[h2]Happy White Day 2022![/h2]

Greetings, fellow lovebirds.

We wish you a wonderful White Day, may your efforts are paid off to the one you love!

On March 14, you may have this warm experience when you can return the love from Valentine's Day, exactly a month before. This wonderful event is often celebrated in Asian countries such as Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea. If you received something from Valentine's Day, you need to return the feelings back during White Day.

Isn't it just sweet to receive back the feelings you gave out after mustering up the courage to do so?

We also want to respond back to all of the love that When The Past Was Around has received. In the game, this is the part where Mr. Owl will try to respond to his feelings to Eda as someone who he cherished the most. White Day event is not limited to couple, you can also celebrate it with your friends and families alike.

[h2]Free Wallpapers for Desktop and Mobile Users! [/h2]

Feel free to download the wallpaper we made especially for White Day. There are a few variations of wallpapers in high resolution you can choose from, both for desktop and mobile users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/f6c2b1eff65b60faff533840943af75cb3096556.png[/img]
One of the wallpapers available, Mr. Owl and Eda in a collage of photo frames. 

You can [url=http://bit.ly/wpwa-wallpaper ]get the wallpapers directly here[/url] and choose which one you prefer to download. You can also download all of them, just in case you might need it one day.

All of the charming wallpapers were made by [url=https://twitter.com/crystalnyam]Brigitta Rena[/url], who also happened to have a livestream with us! Check out Lala together with Rena on Toge Productions Youtube channel as they were drawing and discussing fun topics together~

Don't forget to subscribe to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaJfdsJDP_vzVl-Sl1x0sAw]Toge Productions Youtube Channel[/url], so you won't miss any future livestreams and announcement.

[previewyoutube=eOx5i1o9_4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2] When the Past was Around is Now Available on Mobile Platform! [/h2]

A week ago, we released a teaser for When the Past was Around from our previous post. Now, you can play it for free on any mobile platform you have.

[previewyoutube=N1lxZYNYl9Q;full][/previewyoutube]

We are glad that the game now is more accessible for everyone, so do tell your friends and families to try out the game. Experience the bittersweet story of Mr. Owl and Eda with a slight finger tap, wherever you are~

You can use or share [url=https://linktr.ee/whenthepastwasaround]this main link[/url] which contains the latest information, freebies we gave out, and where to get When the Past was Around. 

Please stay safe and healthy, friends! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/66643bb8ae0e6f02ad52c182224d9ae014d39591.png[/img]

notes.title: When The Past Was Around Trading Card Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/50157ec66c8ef49d27e38766b2dbfe7c7d20889a.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow lovebirds. 

How have you been? We hope the best for all of you, being fine and great throughout the year. 

We have a great announcement for all you lovebirds out there. Starting now, When the Past was Around trading cards are available on Steam! In which, you can gain up to three random trading cards whenever you accumulate your playtime on the game. 

You can get When the Past was Around exclusive badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons. It's definitely great news for our fellow lovebirds to express their love to others on Steam. ːheartrisː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/1487715629ffd76fc54653c2ee2c7d4acaa8f545.gif[/img]
[b][i]Look at how the cute the emoticons are! [/i][/b]

You are now viable to obtain and complete a set of six distinctive cards with different looks of Eda and Owl. The trading cards then be crafted as well so you can upgrade your When the Past was Around badges and display them on your Steam profile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/9cc814eaa058467061227f054ab7c34ac99f3a97.gif[/img]
[b][i]We hope you enjoy the simple yet elegant looks of our favorite Owl in badges. [/i][/b]

Do you enjoy playing When the Past was Around? 
Then you will also love our newest game in development, A Space for the Unbound. It's also a game that is developed by us, Mojiken Studio, and our friends at Toge Productions. 

[b]The demo is currently available[/b] on Steam, feel free to check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201280/A_Space_For_The_Unbound__Prologue/

You can also[b] wishlist the game right now[/b]. We hope the game to be released next year in 2022. Please stay tuned for further information! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

As always, stay safe and healthy, friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/66643bb8ae0e6f02ad52c182224d9ae014d39591.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor Update - v1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/cd8007f1f370249af828f1e6473ee6b27c5cfc8a.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing When the Past Was Around! We have received and acknowledged various issue regarding the game getting stuck in cutscenes. Our team have identified the bugs and we have pushed a new update (v1.0.2) with the fix.

We suspect that the cause of this issue is spamming mouseclicks during the cutscene process. If you encountered this issue, restarting the game and slowing down the clicks during cutscenes might fix it.

Also, if you still encounter the bug, it would be great if you can send your Player.log file to [i]info@togeproductions.com[/i] for us to check.

You can also reach out to us on Steam Discussions, Discord (discord.gg/toge), or our Social Media (twitter.com/WPWAgame)

Team Owl

notes.title: Devlog #03: Sneak Peek Video of the Full Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/5fda0a80c3356d2f9c5b4b5d8018e2753daee3f1.png[/img]

[h1]Hello![/h1]

How are you? XD

Lately we’ve been joining lots of online events, so it’s pretty hectic for us these days. But we’re glad that we’ve been receiving lots of love, also from [b]Steam Game Festival: Summer Edition[/b] last month. Thanks to everyone who came and watched the stream!

Before the Steam Game Festival, we also participated in [i]Wholesome Direct[/i] where we showcased exclusive footage from the full game of [b]When the Past was Around[/b]. We thought maybe we can share the video we submitted here, too!

Check out the full-game footage on the video below!
https://youtu.be/ErAc0fK8DJU

And here’s the link to the full direct video.
https://youtu.be/AwCNzOPR8Ck?t=1088

Soooo… After watching the video, are you excited? Tell us in the comment section!

Oh, right! We also have some news from [b]When the Past was Around[/b]!
The game will be published in Japan by awesome team from Chorus Worldwide and they will also help us with the release and distribution on Nintendo Switch eShop, PS4, and Xbox One! So, yes! We’re coming to consoles as well! Yay yaaayyyy!

Last but not least, we finally have our own Twitter account!
So please follow us on Twitter! <3

TWITTER : http://twitter.com/WPWAgame

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/53cf9667bc7cd2d1324267c6a4dc2bbe83e9106c.png[/img]

[h1]Cross-Promo Time![/h1]

And please also wishlist this upcoming game from our studio, [b]A Space for the Unbound[/b]!
A slice-of-life adventure game set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers.

If you love When the Past was Around, you will probably love this game, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

That’s is for now! We’ll see you on the next devlog!

With love,
Owl Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/66643bb8ae0e6f02ad52c182224d9ae014d39591.png[/img]
